_comment: Authoritative list of everything TfW will supply or decide. Machine-checked by scripts/verify-placeholders.mjs.

fixed.reason: Route implemented by the API; changing requires code change
Vendor security tunable; change via security review
Principle A: UK data sovereignty (eu-west-2). Not changeable

entries.name: Product name
entries.whenToChange: Confirm the official product name
entries.effect: Shown in page titles and emails

entries.name: Legal entity name
entries.whenToChange: Confirm exact legal entity name for notices and DPIA references
entries.effect: Used in legal notices and emails

entries.name: Support email
entries.whenToChange: Replace with the real helpdesk mailbox
entries.effect: Shown to users in error and help text

entries.name: Security contact email
entries.whenToChange: Replace with the real vulnerability-reporting mailbox

entries.name: Notification sender email
entries.whenToChange: Replace; domain needs SPF, DKIM and DMARC configured

entries.name: Portal base URL (web origin)
entries.whenToChange: Set to the real portal domain (no path, no trailing slash)
entries.effect: CORS allow-list on the API, Entra redirect URI. Must equal the address people open the web page at

entries.name: API base URL
entries.whenToChange: Set to the real API domain
entries.effect: Where the web page sends its requests (page meta tag + security policy in index.html and netlify.toml)

entries.name: Extra allowed web origins
entries.whenToChange: Only if additional front-end origins are approved

entries.name: Identity mode
entries.whenToChange: Change to entra ONLY after the Entra adapter is built and tested
entries.effect: simulated = synthetic logins; entra = real sign-in (adapter NOT built yet: app refuses to start in entra mode)

entries.name: Entra tenant ID
entries.whenToChange: Replace with TfW directory (tenant) ID

entries.name: Entra application (client) ID
entries.whenToChange: Replace with the app registration client ID

entries.name: Entra group to role map
entries.whenToChange: Replace each group object ID with the real security group for that role
entries.effect: Maps directory groups to the 8 portal roles

entries.name: TfW systems integration mode
entries.whenToChange: Set live only when formal API access exists and adapter is tested

entries.name: TfW systems API base URL
entries.whenToChange: Replace with TfW API host

entries.name: RISQS verification mode
entries.whenToChange: Set live only with provider access

entries.name: RISQS provider API base URL
entries.whenToChange: Replace with provider host

entries.name: Sentinel/CSCS verification mode
entries.whenToChange: Set live only with provider access

entries.name: Sentinel/CSCS provider API base URL
entries.whenToChange: Replace with provider host

entries.name: Expiry semantics
entries.whenToChange: Confirm against the technical specification (DECISION REQUIRED)
entries.effect: end_of_day_utc: valid through the whole expiry date; exact_instant_utc: valid until 00:00 UTC on that date

entries.name: Cards required for sign-in
entries.whenToChange: Confirm which cards are mandatory
entries.effect: Guard denies sign-in when a listed card is missing or expired

entries.name: QR challenge lifetime (seconds)
entries.whenToChange: Confirm against specification
entries.effect: How long a scanned check-in remains valid

entries.name: Session idle timeout (minutes)
entries.whenToChange: Confirm against specification

entries.name: Session absolute lifetime (minutes)
entries.whenToChange: Confirm against specification

entries.name: Permit validity (hours)
entries.whenToChange: Confirm against specification
entries.effect: Authorised permit expires after this period

entries.name: Audit retention (days)
entries.whenToChange: Set from the DPIA / contract (DECISION REQUIRED)
entries.effect: Retention target; deletion job is not built yet

entries.name: Site list
entries.whenToChange: Replace with real sites: code (A-Z, 0-9, hyphen, 3-20 chars) and display name
entries.effect: Valid sites for permits, QR poster URLs and roll call

entries.name: "Built by" credit line
entries.whenToChange: Change only if the credit wording changes; the Welsh wording is in the P table (TFW-30)
entries.effect: Shown in the page header and footer

entries.name: GitHub organisation handle prefix
entries.providedBy: Repository owner (vendor, then TfW if transferred)
entries.whenToChange: Replace @ORG/ with the real @organisation/ prefix; teams safety-compliance, security, data-protection, frontend must exist
entries.effect: Mandatory code-owner review on safety-critical paths

entries.name: Welsh translation review status
entries.whenToChange: Set to approved only after a qualified reviewer signs off every string

entries.name: Welsh API messages
entries.whenToChange: Replace every value with approved Welsh (keep keys identical to en.json)
entries.effect: Error and reason-code messages in Welsh

entries.name: Welsh UI strings (web)
entries.whenToChange: Replace the Welsh (second) string in every pair of the P table in the inline script, and the Welsh sentence in the loading message inside <div id="app">; then run node scripts/sync-csp.mjs
entries.effect: All Welsh text in the web UI

entries.name: ENTRA_CLIENT_SECRET (or certificate)
entries.whereSet: AWS Secrets Manager (eu-west-2) -> API task environment; not used while identity.mode=simulated
entries.whenToChange: Needed only when the Entra adapter is built and identity.mode=entra

entries.name: Entra app registration redirect URI
entries.whereSet: Entra admin centre -> App registrations -> Authentication. Value: <urls.portalBaseUrl>/auth/callback
entries.whenToChange: Register exactly the derived redirect URI

entries.name: TFW_API_CLIENT_ID / TFW_API_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.whenToChange: Needed only when integrations.tfw.mode=live
entries.effect: Authenticates the portal to TfW systems

entries.name: RISQS_API_KEY
entries.whenToChange: Needed only when integrations.risqs.mode=live

entries.name: CARDS_API_KEY
entries.whenToChange: Needed only when integrations.cards.mode=live

entries.name: Custom domain for the web preview/site
entries.whereSet: Netlify -> Site configuration -> Domain management (preview only); production web domain via TfW DNS
entries.whenToChange: When TfW assigns the domain

entries.name: DNS records (portal, API, email SPF/DKIM/DMARC)
entries.whenToChange: When domains are assigned

entries.name: AWS_ROLE_ARN
entries.whereSet: GitHub -> Settings -> Environments -> production -> Variables (not a secret)
entries.whenToChange: When the AWS account/role is created

entries.name: RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL
entries.whenToChange: Only if Render staging is deployed via hook

entries.name: Remove SIMULATED_USER_PASSWORD; set DATA_CLASSIFICATION=real
entries.whenToChange: At go-live, after identity.mode=entra works
entries.effect: Simulated logins must not exist in a real-data environment (app refuses real data with simulated identity)

entries.name: EXTRA_ALLOWED_ORIGINS (the address the web page is opened at)
entries.whereSet: Render > service > Environment > EXTRA_ALLOWED_ORIGINS. Value = the Netlify address, for example https://your-site.netlify.app (no slash; up to 5, comma-separated)
entries.whenToChange: Whenever the web page is moved to a new address. Not needed once TFW-06 holds the real portal address
entries.effect: Lets the engine accept requests from that web page (CORS)
